subject: batch_record_review_and_release
statement: Batch record review and release procedure with environmental monitoring, BMR review, parameter recording, sampling, and equipment sanitization
supporting_quote: 5.2 Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification. 5.3 Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations. 5.4 Perform batch record review and release according to the approved batch record instructions. 5.5 Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time. 5.6 Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing. 5.8 Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-6514-23.
trigger_conditions: Equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits
Environmental monitoring checks confirm area is within specification
steps: Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification
Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations
Perform batch record review and release according to the approved batch record instructions
Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time
Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing
